visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a grey v-neck sweater and a black jacket, records a selfie video outdoors. She has a subtle smile and light makeup. In the background, a wide river with turbulent grey-green water flows through a forest of leafless, brown trees. The lighting is natural and bright from a clear sky. (2) The scene shifts to a spacious hotel lobby with high ceilings. A large, dark conical fireplace with golden tree-like illustrations stands prominently. Red and dark grey sofas are arranged for guests. Huge glass windows occupy the far wall, providing an expansive view of the bare woodland outside. (3) The woman appears in a blue scarf, pointing at a sign that reads "Oirase Keiryu Hotel". The exterior of the building is visible, showing a rustic yet modern design with dark wood and stone elements under a bright, sunny sky with some clouds. (4) A close-up shot focuses on a clear ice bucket filled with bottles of apple juice. A hand with manicured nails reaches for a glass of light yellow liquid. The background shows a modern indoor setting with warm, ambient lighting and wooden textures. (5) Inside a Japanese-style room, three twin beds are placed side-by-side on a dark wooden platform over tatami mats. The room has neutral grey walls and a large window with a view of trees. The woman is briefly seen in a bathroom mirror wearing a light blue shirt. (6) The buffet area "Aomori Apple Kitchen" is shown. Chefs in white uniforms work behind a wooden counter. Large red apple decorations hang from the ceiling. Close-ups show apple-themed pasta and apple pies. People are seen dining in the background under warm studio lighting. (7) Nature shots of the Oirase Stream show white water rushing over moss-covered stones. A subsequent shot shows the calm blue Lake Towada with mountains in the distance. The lighting is bright and clear, emphasizing the natural colors of the landscape. (8) The video concludes with a screen recording of the Skyscanner mobile app. The interface shows a search for "Oirase Stream" and lists various hotel booking prices and dates. The woman is seen waving goodbye in front of the hotel entrance before the screen transition.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young woman with long, straight black hair, wearing casual but stylish travel attire including a grey knit sweater, a dark jacket, and occasionally a blue scarf.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video transitions between the natural, rugged scenery of the Oirase Stream and Lake Towada, and the high-end rustic interior of the Hoshino Resorts Oirase Keiryu Hotel, featuring a grand lounge and wood-accented dining areas.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat, cheerful acoustic guitar BGM begins immediately. A young female narrator speaks in a friendly, high-energy Mandarin tone. The faint, low-frequency sound of a rushing river is audible beneath her voice, creating a natural outdoor atmosphere. (2) As the narration continues, the acoustic texture shifts to a quieter indoor room tone. The narrator's pitch variability is high as she expresses excitement about the hotel's Michelin rating. The BGM maintains a steady, moderate tempo with light percussion. (3) A distinct, sharp electronic "click" sound effect occurs when the narrator demonstrates a light-up mirror. This transient sound marks a clear production edit. Her voice remains clear and enunciated, following a professional vlog-style delivery. (4) The background atmosphere changes to include the low-frequency murmur of a crowd and the high-frequency clinking of silverware in a dining hall. The BGM continues to provide a rhythmic foundation for the high-density speech. (5) The sound of rushing water returns with increased volume and spectral width, masking some of the room tone. The narrator explains shuttle bus details with a slightly faster speech rate, maintaining a positive and informative valence. (6) The final phase features a persuasive narration about using Skyscanner. The audio quality is clean and studio-like. The BGM remains constant until the very end, where it fades out along with the narrator's closing remarks.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Hotel Environment -> Room Tour -> Food & Dining -> Local Activities -> Practical Travel Tips -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comprehensive travel guide and promotion for Hoshino Resorts Oirase Keiryu Hotel. It aims to persuade viewers to visit the hotel by showcasing its luxury amenities, Michelin-rated scenery, and themed dining, while also positioning Skyscanner as the optimal tool for booking.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The final segment of the video is a dedicated tutorial and recommendation for using the Skyscanner app, featuring a screen recording and verbal call to action.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-quality production combining high-arousal social media editing with beautiful travel cinematography. Strong cluster potential for luxury travel and app-based promotion.
